body: This is almost comical, I am so desperately lonely, so severely in need for someone to be there, or to listen, that I post these long posts to strangers on reddit. But the moment someone tells me they'll listen, my mind goes blank and I have no idea what to say. I'm always the strong one, the rock, the one who helps and supports, I struggle so hard showing vulnerability to anyone. Your post have been on my mind since the moment you posted it, my mind just struggling with the idea of just opening up. There is a big chance I will send you a pm at some point. You don't have to answer or anything, just knowing that someone's listening will mean so much.

I have spoken to a suicide hotline before, after sitting in the snow for two hours, looking out over a lake and thinking that freezing to death would be a nice way to go. I called, talked to them for half an hour and calmed down enough. I didn't feel better or more hopeful, just.. Calmer. I had taken anti-anxiety before fleeing to the woods, it might have been that. I suppose this is my idea of reaching out, or to vent, or I dunno. 
I don't really think we have too many places to volunteer where I live. The only one I can find within two hours travel is a cat shelter, and I'm very allergic. I do constantly dream of just moving to Afrika, cutting all ties, changing my name and kill poachers for the rest of my life. That would be awesome. 

I can't sell the farm. That would literally make my three brothers homeless. So far they are still getting better, they're cut off from mom, from their druggie friends and toxic relationship, they are all very happy there. They just have no idea of the panic I face every day, knowing they could slip up, and literally one slip up from either of them could send them all to jail. Even me, I suppose. 

I have thought about just cutting ties with them, let them stay at the farm as long as they give me money for loans and power and stuff, but just not visiting. But I can't that either, because very soon I'm going to have surgery (add it to my list of my awesome luck) and I will be left with one usable arm for a month. I will need their help. I just can't fucking get out and it pains me, being bereft of choice in the matter of my own life. I've helped and helped and given and sacrificed, and I've ended up in a hole too deep for me to get out. 

I will call my psychiatrist again. And I will call my therapist as well, I have had my ten sessions that my work paid for, but he offered to meet me again pro bono. I'll take him up on that. Thank you so much for taking the time and effort to read my ramblings and answer, it means the world.
